result.title: Where to Generate Touch: Do Image Latents Preserve Material Recognition?
result.summary: Generated touch could extend robot learning beyond recorded contacts. A tactile generator needs a latent space, and we choose one by testing whether a material classifier trained on real GelSight presses still works on encode-decode reconstructions from pretrained image models. On ObjectFolder Real, the classifier loses 6.5 to 9.7 points on reconstructions from three 16x discrete tokenizers and 0.3 points on those from the Stable Diffusion VAE (SD-VAE). The 16x tokenizers again lose far more on Touch and Go and on DIGIT object recognition (YCB-Slide). Retraining the classifier on reconstructions, with no new labels, narrows the discrete gap. SD-VAE reconstructions also keep object identity, with 76.7% object-matching accuracy against 78.9% for real touch and 67.0% for MAGVIT-v2. We therefore select SD-VAE latents and show a photo-to-touch generator trained in them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文比较三种 16× 离散 tokenizer 与 SD-VAE 的图像编码-解码重建，用真实 GelSight 触觉上训练的材质分类器检验重建后识别性能的损失，并据此选择 SD-VAE latent 训练 photo-to-touch 生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 以重建后下游判别性能量化「任务必要信息（材质）是否保留在 latent 中」，为 LVR 中视觉细节保留与信息坍缩的诊断提供了可直接核查的指标思路；但研究对象是触觉生成与图像 latent，未涉及推理期状态生成。
